## Passages
RESULT [labelnoise]: Detected nearly 80% of artificially disturbed boxes at a false-positive rate below 0.1, and improved mAP by 16-46% across datasets after automatic correction (with synthetic noise).
US [labelnoise]: This is a simple, architecture-free cleaning step that can run as a tool of the labeller agent. The gains are measured on injected noise, so expect less on real harvested data.
CORRECTION [labelnoise]: Confirmed: about 80% of disturbed boxes are identified at FPR < 0.1, and mAP improves 16-46% after cleaning. The paper was submitted to ICDE 2024; v3 is dated Dec 2023.
